text:
maya.chen: Heads up — saw ~20% p99 tail perf regression on SM90 after merging triton/flashfusion v4 yesterday. Repro on nightly canary (svc: text-gen). First seen at 03:20 UTC on canary. Anyone digging?

jasper: ugh, I saw that too. p50 ok, p99 jumps with long prompts >1k. Looks like batching heuristics triggering bigger batches.

oliver: logging shows more KV cache misses + re-alloc churn. maybe the Triton kernel path isn't honoring pinned KV pages? sharing perf trace:
```
# perf top sample
triton_fused_attention 45% flash_fuse_kernel
cudaMallocAsync          18% mem_alloc
copy_kv_stage            12% gpu_memcpy
```

devon: can you paste the canary config? batching windows, max_batch_size?

maya.chen: config: `max_batch=64, batch_timeout_ms=12, prefix_cache=true, kv_prefetch=on`

jasper: try forcing smaller max_batch on SM90 (32) and rerun CI microbench. If regression goes away it's batching + kernel combo.

perf-bot: ran smoke microbench (seq=512,batch=64) -> sm90: p99 122ms -> baseline sm80: p99 98ms. artifact: increased cudaMallocAsync calls.

oliver: I think Triton fused kernel is causing extra memory staging for KV when batch > 32. We saw a similar pattern when we enabled paged KV for flashx.

maya.chen: action items: 1) run git bisect between triton/flashfusion v3->v4 on sm90 2) add a runtime selector fallback: if p99 delta >10% prefer cuda-kernel path 3) add microbench variants for batch sizes 8/16/32/64 across cuda vs triton.

devon: starting git bisect now. I'll run on a single SM90 instance with seq 1024 batch 64 + tracing. ETA ~45m.

jasper: also check kernel launch params — grid dims might be suboptimal on SM90 and cause occupancy holes. small tweak in block size helped us before.

oliver: if bisect points at triton change, we should ask triton runtime to check their kernels for memcp patterns. Also consider disabling kv_prefetch on canary as short-term mitigation.

maya.chen: I pushed a canary with `max_batch=32, kv_prefetch=off` to reduce tail. I'll monitor.

perf-bot: alert: canary p99 improved from 122ms -> 104ms after config change. Still ~6% worse than baseline. Keeping monitoring for 1h.

jasper: thanks. keep the bisect logs in thread. If bisect is inconclusive, we'll run perf counters sample (l2/tlb/gmem) and compare.

devon: bisect found offending commit: triton/flashfusion commit 9f3a2e8 - changed shared memory tiling for fused attention. Reverting locally fixes p99.

oliver: good catch. propose: ship a targeted rollback + upstream PR to triton with SM90 tiling patch. We'll also add selector rule: for sm90 with seq>512 and batch>=32 prefer cuda path until patch lands.

maya.chen: agreed. Assigning follow-ups: devon -> rollback PR, jasper -> selector config change + perf tests, oliver -> triton PR + profiling artifacts. I'll notify infra for dedicated canary rollout.

devon: done, rollback PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/triton/compare/rollback-9f3a2e8

maya.chen: thanks all. closing once canary stable. :thumbsup:
